llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, or osseointegration; it focuses on non-biocompatible Al-Si-TNM composites for non-medical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Al-12Si-TNM复合材料的选区激光熔化工艺及力学性能
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化制备复合材料，评估压缩和磨损性能
summary_zh.result: 获得了材料的压缩强度和耐磨性数据

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the selective laser melting process and mechanical properties of Al-12Si-TNM composites for potential structural applications.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate Al-12Si-TNM composites, followed by compressive and wear testing.
summary_en.result: The composites exhibited specific compressive strength and wear resistance characteristics.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (compression and wear) was performed to validate the material properties.
